hero_title: Know the supplier before you wire the deposit.
hero_sub: We verify Chinese suppliers, test samples and compare products for hotels, guesthouses, gyms, spas and wholesalers buying from China, so your first big order is an informed one.
audience: Hotels and guesthouses buying linens, amenities and furniture
Gyms and spas buying equipment, towels and consumables
Wholesalers and small importers sourcing from China for the first time
Companies with no buying team in China

services.title: Supplier verification
services.body: Business registration, export history, factory address and ownership checked against Chinese public records, with a video or on-site visit where needed.

services.title: Product comparison
services.body: Two to five quotes lined up side by side: materials, specs, certificates and why one costs half of another.

services.title: Sample testing
services.body: We receive samples, test them against your spec and send photos, measurements and a pass/fail report.

services.title: Factory audit
services.body: An inspector visits, checks equipment, workers, process and stock, and reports back with photos.

services.title: Negotiation and ordering
services.body: We request quotes, negotiate price and terms, and prepare the purchase contract.

services.title: QC, production and shipping
services.body: Pre-shipment inspection, production follow-up, consolidation and freight to your door.

steps.title: Send us the supplier or product
steps.body: A link, a quote or a WeChat contact is enough.

steps.title: We research and verify
steps.body: Records, calls, samples and visits, depending on the package.

steps.title: You get a clear report
steps.body: Evidence, a risk rating and a plain recommendation.

steps.title: Decide, or let us source
steps.body: Order yourself, or hand us negotiation, QC and shipping.

faq.q: Are you affiliated with any supplier?
faq.a: No. We are paid by buyers only and take no commission from factories.

faq.q: Can you guarantee a supplier is safe?
faq.a: No one can. We reduce risk by checking facts and tell you what we could not verify.

faq.q: How long does a check take?
faq.a: Supplier verification usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Sample testing depends on shipping time.

faq.q: Do you speak the supplier's language?
faq.a: Yes. Our team works in Chinese and English, and handles calls and documents with the supplier.
